text: In 2009, six university students arrive in a remote village in East Java for a community service project, and the village head warns them [never to cross the forbidden gate|rules|break the rule and pay] into the forest of Tapak Tilas. Soon Nur and Widya glimpse [a woman dressed as a traditional Javanese dancer|images|ghosts and strange figures], [Widya performs a ritual dance while possessed|threat|being taken over], and Bima slips away each night to [serve a spirit dancer who has claimed him|wants|a lover to possess].
